userStories.title: Wire AlertManager.check_all() into scan cycle for drawdown, consecutive loss, and weight instability alerts
userStories.description: AlertManager is initialized (line 920) but check_all() is never called. Wire it in scan() after trailing stop evaluation. Needs: nav (from executor._cached_nav), peak_nav (from executor._equity_hwm), recent_trades (from trade_journal_rl.json last 20 entries), current_weights (from agent_team), previous_weights (None ok for first call). Log fired alerts at WARNING. Call every scan cycle (cheap). Store _previous_weights on Scanner for delta tracking.

userStories.title: Wire PortfolioOptimizer.rank_pairs() periodic ranking + should_rotate() in scan()
